verdict: TRACEABILITY_READY_FOR_ADMIN_PORTAL_CONSUMPTION — All 5 traceability chains are verified with zero broken links. All 4 registries are operational and queryable. The backend infrastructure is ready for May Administration Portal implementation. The single structural gap is that access is CLI-only — the registries need a programmatic API layer and web UI. This is a Phased deliverable (P0/P1/P2 at S830/S900/S910) and does not block Framework v2 permanent adoption.
